verdict.rationale: Skyfire is an identity and payments layer for AI agents: it issues and charges kya, pay and kya-pay tokens and runs wallets and settlement. It does not host or author user-defined automations, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations falls outside its product category. The MCP server's 'orchestrate agent commerce workflows' refers to token-issuing tool calls, not stored, versionable automations, and nothing in the evidence shows Skyfire shipping such a capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
